title: Shapes with classes
description:
Model shapes with a base class and subclasses.

```
Circle(r=1): area 3.14
Rectangle(2x3): area 6.00
Square(4): area 16.00
Total area: 25.14
```
hints: A `get name()` getter in each class can build `Circle(r=1)` from its own fields.
`class Square extends Rectangle { constructor(side) { super(side, side); } }` reuses the rectangle's area. `name` needs overriding there too.
requirements: `class Shape` with `area()` that throws `Error("not implemented")`, and `toString()` that uses `name` and `area()`.
A function `totalArea(shapes)` that works for any shape.
stretch: Add `static compare(a, b)` to `Shape` and sort the shapes by area with it.
